<script>
(function(){
  function esconderTudo(){
    const home=document.getElementById('homePanel');
    const quote=document.getElementById('mainQuote');
    const topbar=document.getElementById('mainTopbar');
    const saved=document.getElementById('savedPanel');
    const clients=document.getElementById('clientsPanel');
    const products=document.getElementById('productsAdminPanel');
    const backup=document.getElementById('backupPanel');

    if(home) home.style.display='none';
    if(quote) quote.style.display='none';
    if(topbar) topbar.style.display='flex';

    if(saved) saved.classList.remove('show');
    if(clients) clients.classList.remove('show');
    if(products) products.classList.remove('show');
    if(backup) backup.classList.remove('show');
  }

  function ativarNav(id){
    document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-nav .nav-item').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('active'));
    const item=document.getElementById(id);
    if(item) item.classList.add('active');
  }

  window.mostrarHome=function(){
    esconderTudo();
    const topbar=document.getElementById('mainTopbar');
    if(topbar) topbar.style.display='flex';
    const home=document.getElementById('homePanel');
    if(home) home.style.display='block';
    ativarNav('navHome');
    if(typeof atualizarHome==='function') atualizarHome();
  };

  window.mostrarNovoOrcamento=function(){
    esconderTudo();
    const topbar=document.getElementById('mainTopbar');
    const quote=document.getElementById('mainQuote');
    if(topbar) topbar.style.display='';
    if(quote) quote.style.display='';
    ativarNav('navNovo');
  };

  window.mostrarOrcamentosSalvos=async function(){
    esconderTudo();
    const topbar=document.getElementById('mainTopbar');
    if(topbar) topbar.style.display='flex';
    const saved=document.getElementById('savedPanel');
    if(saved) saved.classList.add('show');
    ativarNav('navSalvos');
    if(typeof renderizarHistorico==='function') await renderizarHistorico();
  };

  window.mostrarClientes=async function(){
    esconderTudo();
    const topbar=document.getElementById('mainTopbar');
    if(topbar) topbar.style.display='flex';
    const clients=document.getElementById('clientsPanel');
    if(clients) clients.classList.add('show');
    ativarNav('navClientes');
    if(typeof renderizarClientes==='function') await renderizarClientes();
  };

  window.mostrarProdutosAdmin=function(){
    esconderTudo();
    const topbar=document.getElementById('mainTopbar');
    if(topbar) topbar.style.display='flex';
    const products=document.getElementById('productsAdminPanel');
    if(products) products.classList.add('show');
    ativarNav('navProdutosAdmin');
    if(typeof renderizarProdutosAdmin==='function') renderizarProdutosAdmin();
  };

  window.mostrarBackup=function(){
    esconderTudo();
    const topbar=document.getElementById('mainTopbar');
    if(topbar) topbar.style.display='flex';
    const backup=document.getElementById('backupPanel');
    if(backup) backup.classList.add('show');
    ativarNav('navBackup');
  };

  // Ensure Home is the initial page only once, while keeping all menu items usable.
  window.addEventListener('load',function(){
    setTimeout(function(){
      window.mostrarHome();
    },0);
  });
})();
</script>

<script>

async function atualizarIndicadoresHome(){
  let orcamentos=[];
  try{
    if(typeof dbGetAll==='function'){
      const dados=await dbGetAll('orcamentos');
      if(Array.isArray(dados)) orcamentos=dados;
    }
  }catch(e){}
  if(!orcamentos.length){
    try{
      for(const chave of ['orcamentos','rprint_orcamentos','orcamentosSalvos']){
        const dados=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(chave)||'null');
        if(Array.isArray(dados)&&dados.length){orcamentos=dados;break}
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }

  const hoje=new Date();
  const mesmoDia=(valor)=>{
    if(!valor)return false;
    const d=new Date(valor);
    if(Number.isNaN(d.getTime()))return false;
    return d.getFullYear()===hoje.getFullYear() &&
           d.getMonth()===hoje.getMonth() &&
           d.getDate()===hoje.getDate();
  };

  const doDia=orcamentos.filter(o=>
    mesmoDia(o.criadoEm || o.createdAt || o.dataCriacao || o.data_criacao || o.data)
  );

  const total=doDia.reduce((s,o)=>{
    let v=o.total ?? o.valorTotal ?? o.valor_total ?? 0;
    if(typeof v==='string'){
      v=Number(v.replace(/[^\d,.-]/g,'').replace(/\./g,'').replace(',','.'))||0;
    }
    return s+(Number(v)||0);
  },0);

  const tarefas=(typeof getTarefasHome==='function')?getTarefasHome():[];
  const pendentes=tarefas.filter(t=>!t.done).length;

  const q=document.getElementById('kpiQuotesToday');
  const v=document.getElementById('kpiValueToday');
  const p=document.getElementById('kpiPendingServices');
  if(q)q.textContent=doDia.length;
  if(v)v.textContent=total.toLocaleString('pt-BR',{style:'currency',currency:'BRL'});
  if(p)p.textContent=pendentes;
}

/* Atualiza os indicadores sempre que a Home for exibida e após alterações nas tarefas. */
const _mostrarHomeIndicadores=window.mostrarHome;
window.mostrarHome=function(){
  const r=_mostrarHomeIndicadores.apply(this,arguments);
  setTimeout(atualizarIndicadoresHome,0);
  return r;
};
const _renderTarefasIndicadores=window.renderTarefasHome;
if(typeof _renderTarefasIndicadores==='function'){
  window.renderTarefasHome=function(){
    const r=_renderTarefasIndicadores.apply(this,arguments);
    setTimeout(atualizarIndicadoresHome,0);
    return r;
  };
}

</script>
<script>

function mostrarServicosPendentesHome(){
  renderServicosPendentesHome();
  document.getElementById('pendingServicesBackdrop')?.classList.add('show');
}
function fecharServicosPendentesHome(){
  document.getElementById('pendingServicesBackdrop')?.classList.remove('show');
}
function renderServicosPendentesHome(){
  const box=document.getElementById('pendingServicesList');
  if(!box)return;
  const tarefas=(typeof getTarefasHome==='function')?getTarefasHome():[];
  const pendentes=tarefas.map((t,i)=>({t,i})).filter(x=>!x.t.done);

  if(!pendentes.length){
    box.innerHTML='<div class="pending-services-empty">Nenhum serviço pendente no momento.</div>';
    return;
  }

  box.innerHTML=pendentes.map(({t,i})=>`
    <div class="pending-service-row">
      <div>
        <div class="pending-service-name">${escapar(t.servico||t.texto||'Serviço')}</div>
        <div class="pending-service-meta">
          <span><b>Orçamento:</b> ${escapar(t.numero||'-')}</span>
          <span><b>Cliente:</b> ${escapar(t.cliente||'-')}</span>
          ${t.qtd?`<span><b>Qtd.:</b> ${escapar(String(t.qtd))}</span>`:''}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="pending-service-actions">
        <button type="button" class="pending-service-done" onclick="concluirServicoPendenteHome(${i})">✓ Concluir</button>
        <button type="button" class="pending-service-delete" onclick="excluirServicoPendenteHome(${i})">Excluir</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}
function concluirServicoPendenteHome(i){
  const tarefas=getTarefasHome();
  if(tarefas[i])tarefas[i].done=true;
  salvarTarefasHome(tarefas);
  renderTarefasHome();
  renderServicosPendentesHome();
  if(typeof atualizarIndicadoresHome==='function')atualizarIndicadoresHome();
}
function excluirServicoPendenteHome(i){
  const tarefas=getTarefasHome();
  tarefas.splice(i,1);
  salvarTarefasHome(tarefas);
  renderTarefasHome();
  renderServicosPendentesHome();
  if(typeof atualizarIndicadoresHome==='function')atualizarIndicadoresHome();
}

</script>

<script>
(function(){
  function definirTelaOrcamento(ativa){
    document.body.classList.toggle('rprint-novo-orcamento', !!ativa);
  }

  const nomes=[
    ['mostrarHome',false],
    ['mostrarNovoOrcamento',true],
    ['mostrarOrcamentosSalvos',false],
    ['mostrarClientes',false],
    ['mostrarProdutosAdmin',false],
    ['mostrarBackup',false]
  ];

  nomes.forEach(([nome,ativa])=>{
    const original=window[nome];
    if(typeof original!=='function') return;
    window[nome]=function(){
      definirTelaOrcamento(ativa);
      return original.apply(this,arguments);
    };
  });

  window.addEventListener('load',()=>setTimeout(()=>definirTelaOrcamento(false),20));
})();
</script>


<script>
const RPRINT_LOCAL_LOGIN_KEY='rprint_local_login_v1';
const RPRINT_LOCAL_USERS_KEY='rprint_local_users_v1';
const RPRINT_LOCAL_SESSION_KEY='rprint_local_session_v1';
const RPRINT_LOCAL_REMEMBER_KEY='rprint_local_remember_access_v1';

async function rprintHash(text){
  const data=new TextEncoder().encode(text);
  const hash=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',data);
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hash)).map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}

function rprintGetUsers(){
  try{
    const users=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(RPRINT_LOCAL_USERS_KEY)||'null');
    if(Array.isArray(users)) return users;
  }catch(e){}

  // Migra automaticamente o login antigo para a nova lista de usuários.
  try{
    const antigo=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(RPRINT_LOCAL_LOGIN_KEY)||'null');
    if(antigo && antigo.user && antigo.passHash){
      const users=[{
        id:Date.now(),
        user:antigo.user,
        passHash:antigo.passHash,
        hint:antigo.hint||'',
        criadoEm:antigo.criadoEm||new Date().toISOString()
      }];
      localStorage.setItem(RPRINT_LOCAL_USERS_KEY,JSON.stringify(users));
      return users;
    }
  }catch(e){}
  return [];
}

function rprintSaveUsers(users){
  localStorage.setItem(RPRINT_LOCAL_USERS_KEY,JSON.stringify(users));
}

function rprintGetLogin(){
  const session=sessionStorage.getItem(RPRINT_LOCAL_SESSION_KEY);
  const users=rprintGetUsers();
  if(session){
    const atual=users.find(u=>u.user===session);
    if(atual) return atual;
  }
  return users[0]||null;
}

function rprintFindUser(username){
  return rprintGetUsers().find(u=>u.user===username)||null;
}

function rprintShowSetup(){
  document.getElementById('localSetupBlock')?.classList.add('show');
  document.getElementById('localLoginBlock')?.classList.add('hide');
}

function rprintShowLogin(){
  document.getElementById('localSetupBlock')?.classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('localLoginBlock')?.classList.remove('hide');
}

function rprintOpenApp(user){
  document.getElementById('localLoginScreen')?.classList.add('hidden');
  const el=document.getElementById('localCurrentUser');
  if(el) el.textContent=user||'Usuário';
  setTimeout(atualizarFotoUsuarioMenu,0);
}

async function criarLoginLocal(event){
  event.preventDefault();
  const user=document.getElementById('localSetupUser').value.trim();
  const p1=document.getElementById('localSetupPass').value;
  const p2=document.getElementById('localSetupPass2').value;
  const msg=document.getElementById('localSetupMsg');
  msg.textContent='';

  if(!user){
    msg.textContent='Digite um usuário.';
    return;
  }
  if(p1.length<4){
    msg.textContent='A senha precisa ter pelo menos 4 caracteres.';
    return;
